steps.en: Officer opens the Special Suffixes setup page in the staff portal
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman pengaturan Special Suffixes di portal staff
steps.why_en: The menu title exists but no page opens; there is nothing for the officer to use.
steps.why_id: Judul menu ada tetapi tidak ada halaman yang terbuka; officer tidak punya apa pun untuk dipakai.

steps.en: Officer adds or changes a special vehicle suffix
steps.id: Officer menambah atau mengubah suffix kendaraan khusus
steps.why_en: No screen or stored list for suffixes exists; changing one needs a developer.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau daftar tersimpan untuk suffix; mengubahnya butuh developer.

steps.en: Officer maintains related details such as country and address
steps.id: Officer mengatur info terkait seperti country dan address
steps.why_en: No country or address data is stored for special vehicles anywhere.
steps.why_id: Data country atau address untuk kendaraan khusus tidak disimpan di mana pun.

steps.en: The change is saved to the database through the system
steps.id: Perubahan disimpan ke database lewat sistem
steps.why_en: Only a plain VIP plate list can be saved, with no screen and no suffix, country or address.
steps.why_id: Hanya daftar plat VIP sederhana yang bisa disimpan, tanpa layar dan tanpa suffix, country, address.

steps.en: The change is used when classifying a vehicle on notice creation
steps.id: Perubahan dipakai saat mengklasifikasi kendaraan di pembuatan notice
steps.why_en: Only the VIP list is read live; diplomat and military suffixes are fixed in the program.
steps.why_id: Hanya daftar VIP yang dibaca langsung; suffix diplomat dan militer tertanam di program.
